_doc: I/L Arch Mage line (spec #319, I2 #321), books 220/221/222. An empty skeleton: each of I6-I10 owns one contiguous region and appends its entries there, so the parallel tickets never collide. I6 (#325): Cold Beam, Thunder Bolt, Teleport (moves from magician.json), Ice Strike, Thunder Spear. I7 (#326): Ice Demon, Element Composition (il). I8 (#327): Chain Lightning. I9 (#328): Ifrit. I10 (#329): Blizzard, Big Bang (il). Energy Bolt and Magic Claw stay in magician.json (F/P's pool entries too).

ifrit._rarity: Tier C: first-pass I9 (#328) bonuses, the Elquines lists (damage, area, one extra ally); repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.64.
ifrit.name: Ifrit
ifrit.desc: Calls a fire ally that follows you and attacks nearby monsters, striking the ones Ice Demon marked first.
ifrit._provenance: Tier A: fire (WZ elemAttr f), WZ time/mad/mastery, summon attack info (identical to Elquines') and art, priority 2221003 (Ice Demon). Tier C: 12 s recast, follow settings, 2.4 s attack cycle, priority_status reading of the WZ priority; GAME_DESIGN 7.64.
